summary: An agent is a loop in which the model chooses its next step. You build the loop with a tool registry, a maximum number of steps and a readable trace, run a stand-in model that looks up three codes and a stubborn one that never stops, and see why your code, not the model, must set the limit.
goal: Run a loop with a maximum number of steps.

items.text: Add agent.py, pretend_agent.py and agent_demo.py and match the three traces
Run with max_steps=2 and predict stopped, the trace and the final text
Remove the step limit, run the stubborn model and say what a real model would cost
Add a stop on the first error and say when it is a bad rule
Play the Agent Loop Check game to the end and see your score
